title: Syracuse Fire Department announces its first Black female captain
summary: Tamica Barnett has been promoted to captain in the Syracuse Fire Department, becoming the first Black female captain in the department's history. This advancement represents a significant milestone for diversity and inclusion within the department's leadership structure.
